BAT1_V_LOAD_DROP.note: Removed; the voltage drop under load is now worked out from the measured current and the cell internal resistance: BAT1_R_INTERNAL when it is 0 or more, otherwise PX4's own estimate. BAT1_R_INTERNAL now defaults to -1 (estimate) instead of 0.005. v1.15.4 used this parameter, with the throttle, only when BAT1_R_INTERNAL was negative or no current was measured; without a current measurement v1.16.0 does not correct for the load drop.

BAT2_V_LOAD_DROP.note: Removed; the voltage drop under load is now worked out from the measured current and the cell internal resistance: BAT2_R_INTERNAL when it is 0 or more, otherwise PX4's own estimate. BAT2_R_INTERNAL now defaults to -1 (estimate) instead of 0.005. v1.15.4 used this parameter, with the throttle, only when BAT2_R_INTERNAL was negative or no current was measured; without a current measurement v1.16.0 does not correct for the load drop.

BAT3_V_LOAD_DROP.note: Removed; the voltage drop under load is now worked out from the measured current and the cell internal resistance: BAT3_R_INTERNAL when it is 0 or more, otherwise PX4's own estimate. BAT3_R_INTERNAL now defaults to -1 (estimate) instead of 0.005. v1.15.4 used this parameter, with the throttle, only when BAT3_R_INTERNAL was negative or no current was measured; without a current measurement v1.16.0 does not correct for the load drop.

BAT_N_CELLS.note: Had no effect: v1.15.4 kept this deprecated name only for QGroundControl and used BAT1_N_CELLS. Removed.

BAT_V_CHARGED.note: Had no effect: v1.15.4 kept this deprecated name only for QGroundControl and used BAT1_V_CHARGED. Removed.

BAT_V_EMPTY.note: Had no effect: v1.15.4 kept this deprecated name only for QGroundControl and used BAT1_V_EMPTY. Removed.

BAT_V_LOAD_DROP.note: Had no effect: v1.15.4 kept this deprecated name only for QGroundControl and used BAT1_V_LOAD_DROP, which v1.16.0 removed as well (see BAT1_V_LOAD_DROP). Removed.

COM_ARM_EKF_HGT.note: Removed; arming is now refused when the EKF height innovation test ratio is above 0.5, a limit fixed in the EKF. The old default was 1.0, so the check is stricter unless it was set lower.

COM_ARM_EKF_POS.note: Removed; arming is now refused when the EKF horizontal position innovation test ratio is above 0.5, a limit fixed in the EKF (the old default).

COM_ARM_EKF_VEL.note: Removed; arming is now refused when the EKF horizontal or vertical velocity innovation test ratio is above 0.5, a limit fixed in the EKF (the old default).

COM_ARM_EKF_YAW.note: Removed; arming is now refused when the EKF heading innovation test ratio is above 0.5, a limit fixed in the EKF (the old default).

COM_OBS_AVOID.note: Removed with PX4's interface to an obstacle avoidance system on a companion computer: Auto modes no longer take its setpoints, and arming no longer waits for it. Collision prevention (CP_DIST) is separate and still available.

COM_POS_FS_DELAY.note: Removed; the position and altitude estimates now count as invalid when they have not been updated for 1 s (the old default 1). Fixed-wing airframes had 5 s by default (rc.fw_defaults).

EKF2_TERR_MASK.note: Removed; the terrain estimate is now part of the EKF and uses the range finder unless EKF2_RNG_CTRL is 0, and optical flow when EKF2_OF_CTRL is 1. There is no separate setting for the terrain: to keep a sensor out of it, turn off its fusion.

FW_SPOILERS_DESC.note: Had no effect: v1.15.4 never read it. Removed.

MIS_PD_TO.note: Replaced by MIS_COMMAND_TOUT. v1.15.4 continued a mission after a gripper or winch command when the payload acknowledged it, or after this timeout (default 5 s). v1.16.0 waits MIS_COMMAND_TOUT seconds after a gripper, winch or gimbal command and does not wait for an acknowledgement; it defaults to 0 (no wait).

MOT_SLEW_MAX.note: Had no effect: v1.15.4 never read it. Removed.

PD_GRIPPER_EN.note: Removed; the payload deliverer now always starts and sets up a gripper of type PD_GRIPPER_TYPE (default 0, servo). To turn the gripper off, set PD_GRIPPER_TYPE to -1 (undefined). PD_GRIPPER_TO now defaults to 1 s instead of 3 s.

RC_MAP_ACRO_SW.note: Had no effect: v1.15.4 reset it to 0 with a warning whenever it was set. Flight modes are selected with RC_MAP_FLTMODE and COM_FLTMODE1 to COM_FLTMODE6.

RC_MAP_MAN_SW.note: Had no effect: v1.15.4 reset it to 0 with a warning whenever it was set. Flight modes are selected with RC_MAP_FLTMODE and COM_FLTMODE1 to COM_FLTMODE6.

RC_MAP_POSCTL_SW.note: Had no effect: v1.15.4 reset it to 0 with a warning whenever it was set. Flight modes are selected with RC_MAP_FLTMODE and COM_FLTMODE1 to COM_FLTMODE6.

RC_MAP_RATT_SW.note: Had no effect: v1.15.4 reset it to 0 with a warning whenever it was set. Flight modes are selected with RC_MAP_FLTMODE and COM_FLTMODE1 to COM_FLTMODE6.

RC_MAP_STAB_SW.note: Had no effect: v1.15.4 reset it to 0 with a warning whenever it was set. Flight modes are selected with RC_MAP_FLTMODE and COM_FLTMODE1 to COM_FLTMODE6.

RDD_ANG_SCALE.note: Removed; v1.16.0 has no manual yaw rate scale. The differential-drive rover module was rewritten as rover_differential, with new parameters (RD_* for this rover type, RO_* shared by all rovers) and different controllers. Set up and tune the rover again; do not copy the old values.

RDD_WHEEL_BASE.note: Renamed to RD_WHEEL_TRACK, with the same meaning: the distance from the centre of the right wheel to the centre of the left wheel, in m. The value is not converted, and RD_WHEEL_TRACK defaults to 0. The differential-drive rover module was rewritten as rover_differential, with new parameters (RD_* for this rover type, RO_* shared by all rovers) and different controllers. Set up and tune the rover again.

RDD_WHEEL_RADIUS.note: Removed; v1.16.0 has no wheel radius. The differential-drive rover module was rewritten as rover_differential, with new parameters (RD_* for this rover type, RO_* shared by all rovers) and different controllers. Set up and tune the rover again; do not copy the old values.

RDD_WHEEL_SPEED.note: Replaced by RO_MAX_THR_SPEED, the speed in m/s the rover drives at full throttle; v1.15.4 took the maximum speed from RDD_WHEEL_SPEED times RDD_WHEEL_RADIUS. The differential-drive rover module was rewritten as rover_differential, with new parameters (RD_* for this rover type, RO_* shared by all rovers) and different controllers. Set up and tune the rover again; do not copy the old values.
